verdict.rationale: Evidence pack shows ChatGPT features (memory, projects, exports for documents) but no mention of a comprehensive data-export mechanism in open/portable formats or account data portability guarantees; no docs reference a 'export your data' or GDPR-style data download feature. missing for 10: documented data export tool/settings, open format specification (e.g., JSON/CSV archive), any community or docs confirmation of full account data portability.
